title: "A Beginner’s Guide to Understanding Neural Networks"
---

## Introduction
In our day and age, Artifial Intelligence (AI) is proving to be a more and more powerful tool. 
Due to its power, some people can see the things it does and think that it is utterly inscrutable. 
However, I want to push back against that idea by teaching you about neural networks! 
Neural networks are the foundation of deep learning, which in turn means that an understanding of neural networks can teach us more about how AI works!
In this blog, I aim to teach you the fundamentals of the basic structure of neural networks, explain how neural networks are trained, and give an example of neural networks in action.

## Tutorial Body
### Basic Structure

![A basic neural network](images/Colored_neural_network.webp)

A tutorial body that explains the main ideas or steps

-	Basic structure of neural networks (neurons, input layers, hidden layers, output)
-	Loss functions/Gradient descent
-	Test/train validation

Examples that help readers understand or apply the idea

-	MNIST data set example
-	Apply each step of the above body to this data set

A conclusion and call to action that gives readers a concrete next step

-	Review my notes and point out any interesting things to follow up on, such as different kinds of neural networks
